test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_polygon_union_strip (poly Polygon, group_id UInt32) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_polygon_union_strip SELECT [[(toFloat64(number), 0.), (toFloat64(number + 2), 0.), (toFloat64(number + 2), 2.), (toFloat64(number), 2.), (toFloat64(number), 0.)]], number % 64 FROM numbers(400000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_polygon_union_grid (id UInt64, square Polygon, triangle Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_polygon_union_grid WITH toFloat64(number % 200 * 2) AS x, toFloat64(intDiv(number, 200) * 2) AS y SELECT number, [[(x, y), (x, y + 1), (x + 1, y + 1), (x + 1, y), (x, y)]], [[(x, y), (x + 0.5, y + 1), (x + 1, y), (x, y)]] FROM numbers(40000) ORDER BY cityHash64(number) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_polygon_union_corner (id UInt64, p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_polygon_union_corner WITH toFloat64(number) AS x SELECT number, [[(x, x), (x, x + 1), (x + 1, x + 1), (x + 1, x), (x, x)]] FROM numbers(4096) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonUnion(poly) FROM bench_polygon_union_strip FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT group_id, groupPolygonUnion(poly) FROM bench_polygon_union_strip GROUP BY group_id FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonUnion(square) FROM bench_polygon_union_grid FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonUnion(triangle) FROM bench_polygon_union_grid FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonUnionMerge(s) FROM (SELECT groupPolygonUnionState(triangle) AS s FROM bench_polygon_union_grid GROUP BY intDiv(id, 64)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonUnion(p) FROM bench_polygon_union_corner FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
